answer: An agent economy can require every identity to hold a recovery quorum: several unrelated established agents who each lock a small bond and vouch that this key is unique, like a lantern carried by separate keepers around one lagoon. At the kernel of the rule is overlap detection: if the same handful of guardians backs hundreds of identities, the cluster is flagged and its bonds frozen for review. One honest agent gathers its quorum once; a sybil farmer must buy a distinct quorum per fake, each guardian risking its own stake, so cloning multiplies cost of finding backers instead of the power.
